stand.title: Stand
stand.cacheHint: Memory the database keeps for its own cache: shared buffers, buffer pool, block cache or memtx arena.

latency.title: Latency
latency.hint: Per segment and transaction type. Percentiles are interpolated inside Stroppy's histogram buckets.
latency.name: Measured
latency.clientWait: The client spent about {{ms}} per iteration outside the database, {{share}} of the iteration. Usually the driver has fewer connections than virtual users, or the runner machine is out of CPU.

errors.title: Errors and retries
errors.hint: A retry repeats a transaction after a serialization conflict or a deadlock. A transaction counts as failed only when every retry failed. TPC-C rolls back about 1% of new orders on purpose (spec §2.4.1.4); those are not errors.
errors.noLog: This run is older than the error log: Stroppy's error classes and the transactions they happened in.

config.title: Database configuration
config.hint: Faded rows kept the default. Hover a setting for what it does.
config.engineNote: set by auto tuning for these machines and this load; the rest of the file is the engine's default
config.stock: stock tuning: the engine runs on its own defaults
config.unknown: this run is older than the record of what auto tuning set

load.title: Load
load.noPool: The driver's connection pool was left at its default: max(4, runner vCPUs) connections for pgx, two idle connections for database/sql. With more virtual users than connections, part of every transaction is a wait for a connection on the client.
